content: Oṃ!To those whose nature is the spontaneous perfection of pure appearance and existence,Residing in the auspicious realms of the ten directions,To the Buddha, the Dharma, and the noble assembly of the Sangha,I prostrate to you all; may there be auspiciousness for us!King of Lamps, Steadfast Prowess, Vision that Fulfills All Aims,Glorious Ornament of Loving-Kindness, Renowned Excellence, and Sacred Splendor,The one renowned for his vast intention toward all,The glorious one renowned for his skill, as exalted as Mount Meru,The glorious one renowned for his concern for all sentient beings,The glorious one renowned for his supreme skill in granting satisfaction,To those whose names alone, when heard, increase glory and auspiciousness,Homage to the eight Sugatas!Youthful Mañjuśrī, glorious Vajrapāṇi,Lord Avalokiteśvara, and the protector, glorious Maitreya,Kṣitigarbha and Sarvanīvaraṇaviṣkambhin,Ākāśagarbha and the supreme noble one, Samantabhadra,With the utpala flower, the vajra, the white lotus, and the naga-tree,The jewel, the moon, the sword, and the sun—Holding these emblems, supreme in auspiciousness and glory,I prostrate to the eight bodhisattvas!The supreme precious parasol, the auspicious golden fish,The wish-granting excellent vase, and the lovely kamala lotus,The conch of fame, and the glorious knot of perfection,The unfailing victory banner, and the sovereign wheel—Bearing these eight supreme precious auspicious signs,They make offerings to the Victors of the directions and times, generating great delight,To the eight goddesses of fortune—Beauty and the rest—who enhance glory by the mere thought of their essence,I pay homage to you!Mahābrahmā, Śiva, and Viṣṇu,The Thousand-Eyed Indra, and King Dhṛtarāṣṭra,Virūḍhaka, and Virūpākṣa, the Lord of Nāgas,Vaiśravaṇa, and the others, who hold divine attributes: the wheel,The trident, the short spear, and the vajra,And who grasp the lute, the sword, the stupa, and the victory banner—Increasing virtue, excellence, and auspiciousness throughout the three realms,I prostrate to the eight guardians of the world!As we now begin this undertaking,May all obstacles and harmful influences be pacified,May our goals and prosperity increase, and our wishes be fulfilled as we desire,And may everything be perfectly auspicious, happy, and well!
